fitting_side_finding_v1.what: v1 (p4_head_fit.py) fitted random-8-head controls at their own optimum and then rescaled them per module to TOP8's Frobenius norm. TOP8 needs ~1.8-2.3x the norm of an all-head o_proj fit, so the rescale moved controls far off their optimum.
fitting_side_finding_v1.reading: FITTING SIDE ONLY (not an endpoint): at their own optimum, random disjoint 8-head sets close the codeword-row KO->clean gap as well as the inherited 8-head set (TOP8 not better on any examined pair). v1 jobs (1023554-7) were cancelled before saving factors; their logs are the only record.

control_families.RAW: KO_RH8RAW_j, j=0..59: random 8-head set from the 24 non-TOP8 heads (seed 4000+100r+j), fitted at its OWN optimum with the identical procedure as TOP8; per-module and total raw norms reported.
control_families.NC: KO_RH8NC_j, j=0..59: same head set, REFIT (not rescaled) under the per-module equality constraint ||B A||_F = ||TOP8||_F via reparametrisation dW = c*BA/||BA||_F, L-BFGS initialised at the RAW optimum (so it can only improve on v1's rescaled point; unit-tested).

decision_rule.per_rank: p_r = max(p_RAW, p_NC) where p_F = (1 + #controls in family F with mean(arm-KO) >= TOP8's)/(60+1). Intersection-union test: TOP8 must beat BOTH families; valid at level alpha without correction across the two families.
decision_rule.across_ranks: Holm over the primary ranks {1,4} on p_r. PASS iff Holm p < 0.05 AND TOP8 recovery CI lower bound > 0 AND gates AND no VOID (decide() from p2b_analyze).
decision_rule.incomplete_family: If either primary rank is missing or not analyzable, EVERY rank's verdict is 'INCOMPLETE FAMILY' (never PASS). Regression-tested (tests/test_p3_p4.py::test_p4v2_incomplete_family_never_passes).
decision_rule.strict_variant_reported_not_decisive: Holm over all 4 tests {r1,r4}x{RAW,NC} is computed and reported. With 60 controls per family its smallest attainable adjusted p is 4/61 = 0.066 > 0.05, i.e. that design is CANNOT ANSWER by construction (mandate §20); making it decisive would need >= 81 controls per family AND TOP8 strictly first in all four tests (+~40 GPU-h). Parent decision if wanted.
decision_rule.power_floor_decisive_rule: p_r floor 1/61 = 0.0164; Holm over 2 ranks: TOP8 must be strictly first against BOTH families at one rank (2 x 0.0164 = 0.0328 < 0.05) and p_r <= 0.05 at the other.
